Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-b.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, please share your update.

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment that the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work that’s waiting on idempotency keys?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot; Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 and the sandbox gateway timeout while you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and because it includes a blocker, it will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, please give your update.

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the task that slipped because the sandbox was down, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Waiting on the sandbox from the platform team, and your commitment: Sync with Maya after the stand-up. Blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and access needed to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions pending security review, and sandbox availability issues blocking progress. The summary page work is on track and will resume once idempotency keys are in. We parked the side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about shared gateway timeout behavior for offline follow-up. task 15 (stale) was not covered, and its owners will get a follow-up; follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses if needed, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
